subject: AWS marketplace stitching: Acme intro & joint account plan
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@amazon.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Acme/Redwood marketplace stitching & next steps

Hi Irene (and Laura),

Quick note from the AWS marketplace side — Acme (Ben Turner) is evaluating a hosted inference + dedicated capacity setup and I think Redwood is a strong fit. I wanted to connect you both to kick off a joint account plan so we can align on co-sell motions and marketplace listing steps (procurement path, entitlements, and any AWS marketplace listing requirements).

High level asks from AWS:
- One-pager + MAP we can share with Acme’s procurement lead
- A suggested next-step agenda for a 30–45m customer call next week
- Any known procurement blockers (SaaS vs. marketplace metering, reserved capacity commitments)

Can you confirm who from Redwood should own the customer intro and who will lead the technical/contract conversations? I can loop in the AWS partner operations team to support listing/entitlement questions.

Thanks — happy to set a tentative meeting if you share availability.

Best,
Sarah Nguyen
Sr. Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
aws-partner-team@amazon.com
(Attachment: AWS_co-sell-checklist.pdf)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@amazon.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Acme/Redwood marketplace stitching & next steps

Thanks Sarah — great timing. Looping in Karthik (Head of Partnerships) to help run the joint account plan and Laura for marketplace ops.

Quick answers:
- Customer intro: I’ll lead the customer intro call and send a mutual action plan (MAP) draft before the meeting.
- Technical/contract owner: Karthik will field procurement questions and coordinate with our legal/finance on marketplace metering vs. direct invoicing.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll share a one-pager + MAP draft (attached) for you to bless and share with Acme procurement.
2) Can Sarah propose 3 x 30–45m slots for next week (we’ll pick one and I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda).
3) If Acme prefers the AWS marketplace purchase path, we’ll confirm which SKU/plan maps to Redwood Dedicated and whether reserved capacity needs to be part of the initial quote.

I attached the draft MAP and a product one-pager. Agenda for the call (suggestion):
- 5m intros
- 10m Acme goals & procurement path
- 15m Redwood solution + deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- 10m Next steps & action owners

Attaching: MAP_Redwood-AWS_v1.xlsx; redwood_product_one-pager.pdf

Thanks — I’m available Thu 07/23 9–11am PT, Fri 07/24 10–12pm PT, or Mon 07/27 1–3pm PT.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Partner Director, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
(Attachment stubs: MAP_Redwood-AWS_v1.xlsx, redwood_product_one-pager.pdf)

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@amazon.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@acme.io>, aws-partner-team@amazon.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Acme/Redwood marketplace stitching & next steps

Thanks Irene — this looks good. Ben — I’m introducing you to Irene (Redwood Partner Director) and Laura (Marketplace Ops). They’ll walk through the MAP and propose the initial purchase path options.

Ben, are you available for a 30m intro on any of these slots? Thu 07/23 10:00–10:30 PT, Fri 07/24 11:00–11:30 PT, or Mon 07/27 13:30–14:00 PT. If none work, send two windows that suit the procurement/legal leads.

A couple of procurement notes for context (Ben):
- If Acme wants to buy via the marketplace, there are entitlements and meter-based SKU considerations; those typically add ~5–7 business days to procurement conversion versus a direct PO path.
- AWS can often enable short-term reservation/commitments if both sides agree — we’ll discuss options on the call.

Irene — once Ben confirms a slot I’ll add the AWS partner-ops alias and a marketplace specialist.

Best,
Sarah
(Attachment: none)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Acme/Redwood marketplace stitching & next steps

Great — thanks for looping me in. I’ll join the customer intro and own the procurement conversation. A few quick internal notes: 
- Legal/Finance will need the finalized MAP + anticipated spend band (ballpark is fine for the first call). Irene, can you add the spend band to the MAP before we share?
- Laura, can you confirm which marketplace SKU maps to Redwood Dedicated (monthly reserved vs on-demand)? If you need a tech spec, I can pull one from the product team.

Irene — please capture action owners in the MAP and we’ll use the HubSpot record to track the outcome. I’ll also prepare a short procurement playbook for Acme if they want the marketplace route.

Thanks — I’ve penciled in Mon 07/27 13:30–14:00 PT pending Ben’s confirmation.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
